description: Browse the three.ws PREMIUM vanity-address inventory — long (4–5+ character) brandable Solana addresses ground ahead of time on batch CPU and sold from stock, which the live grinder cannot reach. FREE and read-only: returns the available patterns, each address, its rarity tier, and a difficulty-scaled price ($1–$50), plus a ready-to-pay x402 buyUrl. Pay that URL (USDC on Base or Solana) to receive the private key exactly once; the ciphertext is destroyed on delivery (delete-after-reveal). Filter by prefix or rarity tier and sort by rarity/price/newest. For a fresh ≤3-char grind instead of buying from stock, use the vanity_grinder tool. CUSTODY: keys are platform-generated — use as a token mint or sweep to self-generated custody, not a treasury. Free — no payment required to browse.
